observations.description: Deliberately schema-less - shape varies per test_id (see policies/catalog/scan_tests.py's parse_observations functions). Two optional keys are worth calling out here since they're not obvious from a field name alone: TEST-FW-MANIFEST's per-package advisories under observations.packages[].kev_listed_count (an int if CISA's KEV catalog was checked for that package, or null if it wasn't - e.g. the static vuln_reference.py fallback table never checks KEV, so null there means 'not checked', never a guessed 0) and each observations.packages[].cves[].kev_listed/kev_date_added (booleans/dates from the same cross-reference). Firmware/HTTP-inspect evidence that used Grype's local vulnerability DB also carries observations.vuln_db_built_at and observations.vuln_db_checksum, citing exactly which DB snapshot produced the finding - present only when Grype actually ran (absent, not null, otherwise).
